te: Complaint about a factory's air treatment system, and the Ban Phaeng relaxed trade point
se: The Department of Industrial Works, the Rayong Provincial Industry Office and the Council of Engineers gave information on the legal criteria for improving a factory's air pollution treatment system, so that the matter can be settled quickly and with good understanding between the state and the business operator. The meeting therefore agreed to invite all the agencies concerned and the petitioner to meet together on 5 November 2025. The meeting also considered the proposal to upgrade the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom, to a permanent border crossing, and agreed to make a study visit to Nakhon Phanom in late November 2025, subject to the committee's approval first (the information is the petitioner's allegation; the subcommittee is fact-finding and this is not a conclusion)
it: A complaint from a private company in Rayong that was ordered to stop operating its factory, on the request for permission to test its air treatment system and the system's design (exhaust stack)
Proposal to upgrade the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom, to a permanent border crossing

te: Complaint about a factory ordered to stop operating, Rayong: hearing environmental information
